visual_connections.description: Developer pushes code updates to Git repository.
Git triggers webhooks into Lagoon EKS platform.
Lagoon EKS manages deployments to the target hosting EKS cluster.
EKS cluster manages workload on base EC2 instances.
EKS cluster provisions non-production/dev workloads on EC2 Spot instances.
EC2 workloads connect to Aurora R6g database.
EC2 Spot workloads provision block storage using EBS GP3.
EC2 Spot workloads connect to shared file system EFS.
